purpose: Diagnose the immutable P9B s01 child-process failure without changing Computer Use or weakening the external stdin/task-resource architecture. The diagnostic replays the frozen s01 physical source with fixture-only instrumentation that reads the existing ephemeral child capture before the s01 source converts a nonzero child exit into the generic P9B_CHILD_PROCESS_FAILED code.

p9bDiagnostic.diagnosticMethod: fixture-only runtime copy of the frozen s01 physical source adds bounded redacted child-capture reporting before the generic child-exit failure; the product and frozen s01 source are not modified
p9bDiagnostic.successMeaning: The diagnostic itself successfully observes and classifies the P9B s01 failure, or observes that the same physical path passes under the diagnostic replay. A diagnostic PASS is not P9B physical validation.
boundedFields: child exit status and bounded stderr
thrown exception name/message with temp/product paths redacted

invariants: external invocation carries only version task resources
resource provenance is explicit and not inferred from UI state
no screenshot OCR payload or coordinates are persisted
diagnostic capture remains ephemeral and temp paths are redacted

promotionOnPass.next: Inspect the exact diagnostic marker from immutable evidence, then either fix only the fixture and prepare P9B s03 physical validation or fix a localized product defect forward-only before a new physical session.

nonClaims: A diagnostic PASS does not make P9B PHYSICALLY_VALIDATED
The diagnostic does not validate the default interactive CLI
The diagnostic does not authorize generic Pulsar behavior
The diagnostic does not authorize UI-derived resource provenance
The diagnostic does not weaken CLICK_POSTED != success
